title: [podman-5.8] seccomp: mask upper bits in socket deny rules
body:
Backport of https://github.com/podman-container-tools/container-libs/pull/1249

Seccomp compares syscall arguments as 64-bit values, but the kernel reads the int parameters of socket(2) from the low 32 bits only. The deny rules for AF_VSOCK and NETLINK_AUDIT therefore did not match when the upper bits were set, so socket(0x100000028, SOCK_STREAM, 0) fell through to the allow rules and the kernel opened a vsock socket.

Compare the low 32 bits with SCMP_CMP_MASKED_EQ. The rules are already listed before the socket allow rules, which libseccomp needs for them to win over the overlapping allows.

Add a test that the deny rules for socket use the mask.

Fixes https://github.com/podman-container-tools/container-libs/issues/1248


(cherry picked from commit 3beb7f638967ef1a6b94c0388682ca3129d9a0c3)
